subject: Fix doubled aspect stretch in detects_position_180_raw
description: From daeacac81's follow-ups: the same doubled INVERSE_ASPECT_RATIO stretch fixed in phalanx_member_detects_180 exists in ai_enemy/util.rs detects_position_180_raw (used by officer sees-me-fighting gate + UnalertAllNearCharlySeekers sweep). ai_enemy/mod.rs:2404 and ai_vision.rs are correct with explanatory comments. Cheap fix but moves officer/Charly behavior — needs sweep validation. ALSO from same report: phalanx advance branch (1-in-3 roll) has 3 deviations — get_normal_right vs GetNormal(true, ASPECT_RATIO) opposite handedness, dropped aspect on the normal, max_norm vs Normalize(ASPECT_RATIO) — needs a trace that rolls the advance.
